registered_after: calibration C-centered local improvement but failed full video; before any residual regression/CV
base: fixed calibration12 C-static centered gain and folded bias from completed experiment
features: actual post-Q1 V1 before FFN0; no test H/V2/Y/Delta enters prediction
training_label: (captured dense Y-native sparse-base Y) in FP32, times actual gate in FP32; calibration12 only
fit: center X and residual label; one training global X RMS; covariance X.T@X/n + lambda*I; FP64 Cholesky whitening, reduced-rank SVD of L^-1 X.T@R/n
CV: two correction-only source folds by calibration index parity, six training/six held-out images each; base was pretrained on all12 and is fixed, so this is NOT held-out CV of the entire pipeline
CV_selection: minimum rank with native BF16 corrected/base risk <=0.75 in both folds at both block20 steps0/2; among passing lambdas choose lowest mean ratio, tie by lambda
native_predictor: two BF16 F.linear calls; fold input centering into first bias, undo constant gate in output factor/bias offline (zero gate gives zero factor), add BF16 predicted Y residual before original BF16 gate/writeback
test: evaluate only the single calibration-CV-selected rank/lambda on frozen task0/task6, both seeds, block20 steps0/2
heldout_gate: corrected native risk <=0.75 matched fixed C-centered base in >=3/4 scopes with seed/step coverage, independently per source
precision: native CPU BF16 primary held-out projection, same dequantized BF16 parameters in matched FP32 control
deployment: auxiliary BF16 weights and both auxiliary GEMMs must be reported/counted; main FFN0/FFN2 remain50%; no cheap selector or novel-theory claim
full_fit_if_passed: freeze the chosen global rank/lambda; fit every160 position from calibration12 without further validation selection
